title: Localization of actual chart sections on overlaps
statement: Let A be a commutative ring, h:Y → Spec A a scheme morphism, t ∈ ℕ and f:Fin t → A. Suppose each V_i=h⁻¹D(f_i) is affine. Use the fixed section modules M_i from [def-sbc-punctured-completion-chart-section-modules]. There exist A-linear equivalences alpha_ij:(M_i)_(f_j) ≃ (M_j)_(f_i) and additive equivalences b_ij:(M_j)_(f_i) ≃ Γ(Y,V_i ∩ V_j). They are constructed together, and satisfy b_ij(alpha_ij(m/1))=m restricted from V_i, b_ij(n/1)=n restricted from V_j, and b_ij(a x)=the structural section of a times b_ij(x). No preassigned transitions occur among the hypotheses.

source.place: Tag 0BLH, first two proof paragraphs; Tag 05EL, item (1).

proof.text: Apply exists_chart_section_localization separately to each ordered pair, once to localize chart j at f_i and once to localize chart i at f_j, choosing the same overlap open in both cases using inf_comm. Let b_ij be the additive equivalence underlying the first linear equivalence. Define alpha_ij as the second linear equivalence followed by the inverse of the first. Cancellation gives the first restriction formula; the first equivalence directly gives the second. Its A-linearity gives the structural scalar formula.
